Warranty Replacement Request – NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 (Order Shop····‑A)

To whom it may concern,

My NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 (6TH/s), Order *Shop····‑A*, has stopped
functioning. The fuse burned out, and I replaced it with a new one of the
same amperage. I tried several fuses, but the unit still will not power on.

The power supply is not the issue—I tested it with other bitcoin miners and
confirmed it works. I also attempted to use a different Mean Well power
supply with the affected unit, but it still does not turn on.

Can you advise on how to proceed with obtaining a replacement under the
warranty?

Thank you, Jesse
Note to the team: Verdict recorded as a board-level fault; the chat is back with Sarah for the return decision.
